metadata.title: My CV in 30 Seconds | Build your CV with AI
metadata.description: Answer 5 questions and AI will write a professional CV for you in seconds. Start for free.

home.title: Your professional CV <highlight>in seconds</highlight>, ready to get past recruiters' filters.
home.subtitle: Answer 5 questions and AI writes a clear, well-structured CV that applicant tracking systems can read. Review it, fine-tune it and download it as a PDF.
home.illustrationAlt: A candidate creates their CV on a laptop and it's approved in 30 seconds.

wizard.metaDescription: Answer 5 simple questions and AI writes your CV, ready for applicant tracking systems.
wizard.title: Create your CV in 5 questions
wizard.intro: Answer simply, in your own words. AI writes and formats your CV.
wizard.jobRequired: Enter the job you're aiming for to continue.
wizard.shortAnswers: Your answers are quite short. The more detail you give (jobs, tasks, tools, degrees), the more accurate your CV will be.
wizard.languageHint: You can answer in any language: your CV will be written in this one.
wizard.freeHint: Generating your first CV is free. Your answers stay saved on this device.

job.title: What job are you aiming for?
job.help: The position or profession you're looking for. This is the only required answer.

experiences.title: What's your work experience?
experiences.help: Jobs, companies, dates and main tasks. Write freely and AI will organise it all.
experiences.example:
Web developer at Studio Lumière, Lyon, 2021 to present: building websites for shops, implementing design mock-ups, client follow-up.
6-month internship at WebAgence in 2020: WordPress website maintenance.

skills.title: What are your skills?
skills.help: Tools, software, languages, practical skills and personal qualities. Separate them with commas or new lines.
skills.example: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Figma, teamwork, fluent French

education.title: What's your education?
education.example:
Bachelor's degree in Digital Media, University of Manchester, 2020
A-levels, 2017

goal.title: What is your career goal?
goal.help: What you're looking for: type of role, sector, contract, how you'd like your career to progress.
goal.example: Join a product team to build accessible web applications, on a permanent contract in Manchester or remotely.
